author: The Infographics Show
description:
Insane Big Pharma conspiracies that turned out to be true sound like fiction, but many were exposed through court records, internal emails, government investigations, whistleblowers, and corporate settlements. From deadly drug trials and hidden side effects to price manipulation and opioid marketing, some of the pharmaceutical industry’s darkest scandals were far worse than the public initially suspected.

This countdown examines Purdue Pharma and the OxyContin crisis, Pfizer’s controversial Trovan trial in Nigeria, Insys Therapeutics bribing doctors to prescribe fentanyl, Merck’s handling of Vioxx risks, and allegations that Johnson & Johnson knew its talc products could contain asbestos. It also explores pharmaceutical patent evergreening, inflated research costs, whistleblower intimidation, manipulated clinical data, and companies prioritizing long-term revenue over affordable cures.
